name: Mouse Enhancement
author: hwf1324
description: This add-on provides enhancement to mouse functionality in NVDA. For example: Fixed mouse tracking in Electron app (Only 2024.4 or later). Electron apps, such as VS Code. Experimental fix for mouse tracking in WinUI apps. WinUI applications: e.g. Windows Terminal, PowerToys v0.86.0 and higher, some applications that come with Windows, etc. Automatically update the mouse object.
